inspectedText: Walker describes his hot-plate experiments: direct-contact drops disappear quickly below the transition; the bottom vaporizes promptly at the transition, pressure supports the remaining liquid, and an insulating layer is replenished. Later compiled primary experimental results discuss surface roughness, deposits and thermal properties affecting the transition. No single numeric threshold is transferred to pans.
